description: Get the top-level structure (chapters/subtitles) of one CFR title — the agencies and major divisions within that title. Returns a summarized one-level view, not the full deep tree. Keyless.

date.description: Optional point-in-time date, YYYY-MM-DD. If omitted, the title's current 'up_to_date_as_of' date is used automatically.

title.description: CFR title number, 1–50 (e.g. 14 = Aeronautics and Space).

name: title_structure
